wordle-solver.title: WordleSolver
wordle-solver.desc: A C++ solver designed to find 5-letter Wordle secret words efficiently using Information Theory. The application calculates the entropy H = Σ p_i * log2(1/p_i) for each candidate word against all 243 possible color pattern combinations (3⁵). The guess with the highest entropy is prioritized to minimize the remaining word space.

arduino-ambilight.title: Arduino Ambilight
arduino-ambilight.desc: An ambient lighting system driving a WS2812B addressable LED strip around a display. The Arduino Leonardo receives color data over serial using the Adalight protocol from Prismatik (configured at 115200 baud). The strip is powered directly via an external 5V 2A power supply.
